# SynergyUI — AI-readable API reference

SynergyUI is a Roblox Lua UI library. The public object graph is `SynergyUI → Window → elements`. The implementation source is [`dist/main.lua`](https://github.com/Xyraniz/SynergyUI/blob/main/dist/main.lua) and the machine-readable index is [`web/api.json`](https://github.com/Xyraniz/SynergyUI/blob/main/web/api.json).

## Official loader

The distributed implementation is a Lua chunk that returns the `SynergyUI` table. It is not a Roblox `ModuleScript` loaded with `require`; the supported documentation flow downloads the raw file and executes it with `loadstring`:

```lua
local SynergyUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xyraniz/SynergyUI/main/dist/main.lua"))()
```

The loader requires an environment that permits the HTTP request and Lua execution. The URL tracks the repository `main` branch. The runtime source was checked against `dist/main.lua`; icon loading is pinned internally to commit `03461a61928eb42028daeffe56268e3fff294fba` at `src/Icons/<set>/Icons.lua`.

## Global API

```lua
SynergyUI:CreateWindow(options) -> Window
SynergyUI:Notify(options: table|string) -> nil
SynergyUI:CreateGameNotification(options: table) -> nil
SynergyUI:Alert(options: table|string) -> Dialog
SynergyUI:Confirm(options: table|string) -> Dialog
SynergyUI:Prompt(options: table|string) -> Dialog
SynergyUI:AddTranslations(language: string, translations: table) -> boolean
SynergyUI:SetLanguage(language: string) -> boolean
SynergyUI:GetLanguage() -> string
SynergyUI:GetTranslations() -> table
SynergyUI:Localization(config: table) -> boolean
SynergyUI:Locations(config: table) -> boolean -- alias of Localization
SynergyUI.Localize(value: any) -> any
SynergyUI:RegisterTheme(name: string, theme: table) -> boolean
SynergyUI:GetThemes() -> array<string> -- sorted
SynergyUI:GetTheme(name: string) -> table|nil -- normalized clone
```

`Notify` accepts either a message string or a table with `Message`, `Type` (`info`, `done`, `error`, `warning`), `Duration`, `Position`, `TypeColor`, `Parent`, and optional `Callback`. `CreateGameNotification` accepts `Parent`, `Image`, `Title`, `MiniTitle`, `Description`, `YesText`, `NoText`, `YesCallback`, and `NoCallback`.

`Localization` accepts `FallbackLanguage`, `Language`, and `Translations`. `Localize` resolves only strings beginning with `@`; it checks the active language, then the fallback language, then returns the key without `@`.

## Dialog options

`Alert`, `Confirm`, and `Prompt` accept the following table fields. A string argument is shorthand for `{ Content = string }`.

| Option | Type | Default / behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Title` | string? | `@Alert`, `@Confirm`, or `@Prompt` by dialog type. |
| `Content` / `Description` | string? | `""`. Wrapped dialog body. |
| `AccentColor` | Color3? | Default blue accent. |
| `BackgroundColor` | Color3? | Default dark card background. |
| `Parent` | Instance? | Default UI parent. |
| `OwnerWindow` | Window? | Assigned automatically by Window methods. |
| `CloseOnOverlay` | boolean? | `true`; overlay click closes the dialog. |
| `CloseOnEscape` | boolean? | `true`; Escape closes the dialog. |
| `ConfirmText` / `OkText` | string? | `@Accept`, or `@Continue` for Prompt. |
| `CancelText` | string? | `@Cancel`; used by Confirm and Prompt. |
| `DefaultText` | string? | `""`; Prompt input initial value. |
| `Placeholder` | string? | `""`; Prompt input placeholder. |
| `ConfirmCallback` | function? | Confirm-only callback receiving the dialog on confirm. |
| `CancelCallback` | function? | Confirm-only callback receiving the dialog on cancel. |
| `Callback` | function? | Alert receives `(dialog)`; Confirm receives `(result, dialog)`; Prompt receives `(value, dialog)`. |

The returned dialog exposes `Input` for Prompt, `Close(result)`, and `Destroy()`. For Prompt, clicking the Cancel button passes `nil` to `Callback`; closing through overlay or Escape passes `false`.

## CreateWindow

```lua
local Window = SynergyUI:CreateWindow(options) -> Window
```

| Option | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Title` | string | `"Synergy Hub"` | Accepts `@Key` localization references. |
| `Subtitle` | string? | `nil` | Optional localized subtitle. |
| `Theme` | string/table | `"Dark"` | Registered theme name or custom theme table. |
| `AccentColor` | Color3? | `nil` | Overrides the theme accent. |
| `Background` / `BackgroundAsset` | number/string? | `nil` | Numeric ID, decimal string, or `rbxassetid://...`. |
| `BackgroundImageTransparency` | number | `0.52` | Clamped to `0..1`. |
| `BackgroundScaleType` | Enum.ScaleType? | `Enum.ScaleType.Crop` | Non-Enum values fall back to Crop. |
| `ToggleKey` | Enum.KeyCode/string? | `Enum.KeyCode.RightShift` | Use `"None"` to disable. |
| `Parent` | Instance? | CoreGui or PlayerGui in Studio | Parent of the ScreenGui. |
| `ConfigName` | string | `"default_config"` | JSON name under `SynergyUI/Settings`. |
| `Localization` | table? | `nil` | Initial `FallbackLanguage`, `Language`, and `Translations`. |
| `Language` | string? | `nil` | Initial global language. |
| `IconSet` | false/string/array? | all built-in sets | `false` disables loading; a string selects one set and an array selects several sets in the provided order. |
| `CloseOnEscape` | boolean? | false | When truthy, Escape destroys the window. |
| `OnOpen` / `OnClose` / `OnDestroy` | function? | `nil` | One callback per event option; runs on every matching event and complements registered hooks. |

A new window starts visible at `560 × 380`. The default configuration name is `default_config`. The window exposes its controls through `Window.Flags`.

## Window methods

```lua
Window:SetToggleKey(keyName: string) -> Window
Window:OnOpen(callback: function(Window)) -> Window
Window:OnClose(callback: function(Window)) -> Window
Window:OnDestroy(callback: function(Window)) -> Window
Window:IsOpen() -> boolean
Window:Open() -> Window
Window:Close() -> Window
Window:Toggle() -> Window
Window:RefreshTheme() -> nil
Window:SetTitle(value: string) -> nil
Window:SetSubtitle(value: string|nil) -> nil
Window:SetBackground(asset: number|string, transparency: number?) -> boolean
Window:RefreshLocalization() -> nil
Window:SetLanguage(language: string) -> boolean
Window:Alert(options: table) -> Dialog
Window:Confirm(options: table) -> Dialog
Window:Prompt(options: table) -> Dialog
Window:SetAccent(color: Color3) -> nil
Window:SetTheme(themeValue: string|table) -> Window
Window:Destroy() -> Window
Window:CreateTab(name: string, icon: string|table|nil) -> Elements
```

`Window:SetLanguage` delegates to `SynergyUI:SetLanguage`, so it updates all active windows and returns `false` for a non-string argument. `Window:RefreshLocalization` re-resolves registered localized properties and recalculates this window's title layout without changing the active language. `Window:SetToggleKey` is a colon-style method, accepts a key name string or `"None"`, returns the window, and leaves the existing key unchanged for an invalid name. `Window:Alert`, `Window:Confirm`, and `Window:Prompt` assign `OwnerWindow` automatically so the dialogs are destroyed with the window.

`Window:SetBackground` removes the current image and returns `false` when the asset is invalid; valid numeric or asset-id strings return `true`. `Window:SetTheme` accepts a registered name or a custom table, normalizes it, refreshes the controls, and persists `__theme` when a registered name is used. `Window:CreateTab(name, icon)` resolves a named icon from the selected sets; `rbxassetid://...` strings, HTTP URLs, and descriptor tables are used directly, while numeric strings are not normalized for tabs.

## Elements namespace

`Window:CreateTab(name, icon)` returns an `Elements` namespace. The first created tab becomes active.

### Layout builders

```lua
Elements:CreateSection(name: string) -> TextLabel
Elements:CreateLabel(text: string) -> TextLabel
Elements:CreateSeparator() -> Frame
Elements:CreateParagraph(options) -> Frame
Elements:CreateImage(options) -> Frame
Elements:CreateVideo(options) -> Frame
```

| Builder | Options | Return |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CreateSection` | `name` | `TextLabel` |
| `CreateLabel` | `text` | `TextLabel` |
| `CreateSeparator` | none | `Frame` |
| `CreateParagraph` | `Title`, `Content`, `Image`, `ImageDescription` | `Frame` with measured height |
| `CreateImage` | `Title`, `Image`, `Description` | Collapsible `Frame` |
| `CreateVideo` | `Title`, `Video`, `Looped`, `Volume` | Collapsible `Frame` |

`CreateParagraph` defaults missing title/content/image fields to empty values. `CreateImage` uses `@Image` as its default title. `CreateVideo` uses `@Video`, `Looped = false`, and `Volume = 1`.

### Button

```lua
Elements:CreateButton(options) -> Frame, RBXScriptConnection
```

Options are `Name` (required in practice), `Tooltip` (optional), and `Callback` (function). The callback runs on click and is protected with `pcall`. A callback error is surfaced as an error notification.

### Boolean controls

```lua
Elements:CreateToggle(options) -> Frame, RBXScriptConnection
Elements:CreateCheckBox(options) -> Frame, RBXScriptConnection
```

| Option | Type | Default / behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | string | Required label; accepts `@Key`. |
| `Flag` | string? | Falls back to `Name`. |
| `CurrentValue` | boolean? | `false` when no valid saved boolean exists. |
| `Callback` | function? | Receives the boolean value. |

The returned values are the visual `Frame` and its `RBXScriptConnection`; the state objects are available as `Window.Flags[Flag]` (or `Window.Flags[Name]` when `Flag` is omitted). Those flag objects expose `GetValue() -> boolean` and `SetValue(value: boolean)`. A saved boolean wins over `CurrentValue`. Toggle and CheckBox call the callback during construction only when the initial state is true.

### Slider

```lua
Elements:CreateSlider(options) -> Frame, array<RBXScriptConnection>
```

| Option | Type | Default / behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | string | Required label. |
| `Flag` | string? | Falls back to `Name`. |
| `Range` | `{ number, number }` | Required; `{ min, max }`. |
| `Increment` | number? | `1`; rounds drag, numeric input, and `SetValue`. |
| `CurrentValue` | number? | Range minimum when absent and no saved number exists. |
| `Callback` | function? | Receives the numeric value. |

The returned values are the visual `Frame` and an array of four input connections. The state object is available as `Window.Flags[Flag]` and exposes `GetValue() -> number` and `SetValue(value: number)`. Saved numeric values are clamped to the range.

### Progress bar

```lua
Elements:CreateProgressBar(options) -> ProgressFlag
Elements:CreateProgress(options) -> ProgressFlag -- alias
```

| Option | Type | Default / behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | string? | `@Progress`. |
| `Flag` | string? | Falls back to `Name`, then `"Progress"`. |
| `Range` | `{ number, number }`? | If absent, effective range is `0..100`. |
| `Min` / `Max` | number? | Alternative to `Range`; `0` and `100` by default. |
| `CurrentValue` | number? | Range minimum when absent. |
| `Format` | function(current, ratio)? | Custom value-label formatter. |
| `ShowPercentage` | boolean? | Adds a rounded percentage suffix. |
| `ShowValue` | boolean? | `true`; `false` hides the value label. |
| `Callback` | function? | Receives `(value, ratio)` on updates. |

The returned value is the progress flag object, also stored at `Window.Flags[Flag]`; it exposes `GetValue()`, `GetPercentage()`, `SetValue(value)`, and `SetProgress(value)`.

### Dropdown

```lua
Elements:CreateDropdown(options) -> DropdownFlag, RBXScriptConnection
```

| Option | Type | Default / behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | string | Required label. |
| `Flag` | string? | Falls back to `Name`. |
| `Options` | array<string> | Empty array when absent. |
| `CurrentOption` | string? | Initial single-select value. |
| `CurrentSelected` | array<string>? | Initial multi-select values. |
| `MultiSelect` | boolean? | `false`. |
| `Searchable` | boolean? | `false`; adds a search field when true. |
| `Callback` | function? | Single-select receives `value`; multi-select interaction receives `(option, selected)`. |

Single-select priority is saved valid value, then `CurrentOption`, then the first option or `""`; when a selection exists after construction, the single-select callback runs with that value. Multi-select priority is saved array, then `CurrentSelected`, then no selections. The returned flag object and the same object at `Window.Flags[Flag]` expose `GetValue()`, `SetValue(value)`, `AddOption(option)`, `RemoveOption(option)`, `ClearOptions()`, and `Select(value)`. `GetValue` returns a string in single-select mode and an array in multi-select mode; arrays assembled from Lua maps have no guaranteed order.

### Checklist

```lua
Elements:CreateChecklist(options) -> ChecklistFlag, RBXScriptConnection
```

Options are `Name`, `Flag`, `Options` (array), `CurrentSelected` (array), and `Callback`. The returned flag object, also stored at `Window.Flags[Flag]`, exposes `GetValue() -> array<string>`, `SetValue(values)`, `AddOption(option)`, and `RemoveOption(option)`. It intentionally does not expose `ClearOptions` or `Select`. The callback receives the internal selection map `{ [option] = boolean }` and runs during the initial build and after `SetValue`, `AddOption`, or `RemoveOption`, because those operations rebuild the list.

### Text and number inputs

```lua
Elements:CreateTextInput(options) -> TextFlag, RBXScriptConnection
Elements:CreateNumberInput(options) -> NumberFlag, RBXScriptConnection
```

`CreateTextInput` returns a flag object and one focus connection. It accepts `Name`, `Flag`, `CurrentText`, `Placeholder`, and `Callback`; the default text is `""`, and the callback receives the text on focus loss. The flag is also stored at `Window.Flags[Flag]` and exposes `GetValue() -> string` and `SetValue(value: string)`. `SetValue` changes the textbox directly and does not invoke the callback or schedule persistence by itself.

`CreateNumberInput` returns a flag object and one focus connection. It accepts `Name`, `Flag`, `CurrentValue`, and `Callback`; the default is `0`. It filters input to digits, decimal point, and minus sign, accepts a convertible number on focus loss, and restores the previous value for invalid text. Its flag is also stored at `Window.Flags[Flag]`, exposes `GetValue() -> number` and `SetValue(value) -> nil`, and `SetValue` updates the text, invokes the callback, and schedules persistence.

### Keybind

```lua
Elements:CreateKeybind(options) -> KeybindFlag, array<RBXScriptConnection>
```

`CreateKeybind` returns a flag object and an array of two connections. Options are `Name`, `Flag`, `CurrentKeybind`, and `Callback`. The default keybind is `"None"`. The control captures keyboard keys and mouse buttons; Escape is stored as `"None"`, and a capture expires after five seconds. The flag is also stored at `Window.Flags[Flag]`, exposes `GetValue() -> string` and `SetValue(value: string)`. When `Flag = "Keybind"`, the window toggle key is synchronized with the control.

### Color picker

```lua
Elements:CreateColorPicker(options) -> ColorFlag, RBXScriptConnection
```

`CreateColorPicker` returns a flag object and one expansion connection. Options are `Name`, `Flag`, `Color`, and `Callback`. The default color is `Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)`. The flag is also stored at `Window.Flags[Flag]`, exposes `GetValue() -> Color3` and `SetValue(color: Color3)`. Rainbow mode updates the color continuously and is stopped when the window is destroyed or when `SetValue` is called. Persisted values use `{ __type = "Color3", r = color.R, g = color.G, b = color.B }`.

### Radio group

```lua
Elements:CreateRadioGroup(options) -> RadioFlag, nil
```

Options are `Name`, `Flag`, `Options` (required array), `CurrentValue`, and `Callback`. The flag exposes `GetValue() -> string` and `SetValue(value: string)`. **Priority exception:** a valid `CurrentValue` is checked before the saved flag; only when it is absent or invalid does the saved valid value win, followed by the first option. The initial selection does not invoke the callback.

## Value priority summary

For most flagged controls, a saved value with the expected type wins over the current option. Dropdown also requires a saved selection to exist in its current `Options` list. Control-specific current options are `CurrentValue`, `CurrentOption`, `CurrentSelected`, `CurrentText`, and `CurrentKeybind`. `CreateRadioGroup` is the exception: valid `CurrentValue` wins over a saved flag.

## Persistence and cleanup

When filesystem helpers exist, configuration is stored at `SynergyUI/Settings/<ConfigName>.json`. The optional helpers are `isfolder`, `makefolder`, `isfile`, `readfile`, and `writefile`. Runtime keys include control flags, `__size`, `__minimized`, `__theme`, and legacy `__position` cleanup. `Window:Destroy()` closes dialogs and overlays, disconnects resources, cancels rainbow tasks, removes the window from localization state, and destroys its GUI.

## Themes and icons

Built-in themes are `Dark`, `Slate`, `Ivory`, `Sage`, `Burgundy`, `Sandstone`, and `Ocean`. The icon sets are `lucide`, `gravity`, `craft`, `geist`, `sfsymbols`, and `solar`. Icon loading is optional with `IconSet = false`; the runtime fetches the selected sets from pinned commit `03461a61928eb42028daeffe56268e3fff294fba`, and when duplicate names are merged the first loaded definition wins.

## Source of truth

When this file conflicts with prose elsewhere, verify the current implementation in [`dist/main.lua`](https://github.com/Xyraniz/SynergyUI/blob/main/dist/main.lua) and the structured contracts in [`web/api.json`](https://github.com/Xyraniz/SynergyUI/blob/main/web/api.json). The public raw loader is [`dist/main.lua` on GitHub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xyraniz/SynergyUI/main/dist/main.lua).
